directories.name: Yelo Mauritius
directories.offers: General business directory, running since 2009, with 11,344 company listings and 858 reviews. Profiles carry contact details, opening hours, map location, photos, products and job offers. It also sells a 'Data Hub', a searchable table of its business contacts.
directories.pricing: Paid. Basic listing USD 20, one-time payment (regular price USD 40). Premium listing USD 65 a year (regular price USD 130). Lifetime listing USD 145, one-time payment (regular price USD 290). All three were shown at 50% off on 20 November 2026. No free tier is shown on the home page. Data Hub prices are on a separate page that was not read.

directories.name: Yellow.mu (Mauritius Yellow Pages, The MYP Network)
directories.offers: Business directory for Mauritius. The home page says it offers free and premium listing options and links to yellowpagesmauritius.com for search and registration. It carries banner advertising.
directories.pricing: Free and premium listings; prices not published on the page read. The main site, yellowpagesmauritius.com, disallows AI agents in its robots.txt, so its pages were not read.

directories.name: MCCI Members Directory (Mauritius Chamber of Commerce and Industry)
directories.offers: Directory of chamber members. Members get a free entry in the MCCI Membership Directory and free access to the MCCI Business Club (stated at https://mcci.org/en/membership/why-join-the-mcci/). The chamber also runs an SME Marketplace for members.
directories.pricing: Listing is free for members; membership is paid. Subscription fees by gross annual turnover: MUR 8,000 (up to MUR 5,000,000), MUR 10,000 (up to MUR 10,000,000), MUR 20,000 (MUR 10,000,000 to MUR 25,000,000), MUR 35,000 (MUR 25,000,000 to MUR 100,000,000), MUR 60,000 (MUR 100,000,000 to MUR 200,000,000), MUR 75,000 (MUR 200,000,000 to MUR 500,000,000), MUR 90,000 (MUR 500,000,000 to MUR 1 billion), MUR 110,000 (above MUR 1 billion). The form does not state the period the fee covers.

directories.name: Expat.com business directory, Mauritius
directories.offers: Directory of companies and professionals by category, aimed at expatriates. Some listings are marked Premium. Businesses can be added or recommended by members.
directories.pricing: Prices not published. The 'Add your business' page redirects to the directory home for visitors without an account.

directories.name: EDB e-Export Directory
directories.offers: Government directory run by the Economic Development Board where Mauritian exporters list their profiles, products and services for foreign buyers. The directory itself was not opened; the description is from the EDB article.

not_found: Number of establishments or number of SMEs (stock): not confirmed. The Statistics Mauritius SME series gives employment, value added and exports only. The Census of Economic Activities 2018 establishment count and the SME Mauritius register were not read.

Total number of registered sole traders (stock): not published on the CBRD statistics page, which gives new individual business registrations by year only. The CBRD live count covers companies, foundations and partnerships.
CBRD annual report: not read. Figures are from the CBRD Statistics page charts.

Mauritius Yellow Pages prices (yellowpagesmauritius.com): not read. Its robots.txt disallows AI agents, so the site was left alone after one request that returned 404. Yellow.mu states free and premium listings without prices.
MT Yellow Pages (mtyellowpages.mu, named in a search result as the Mauritius Telecom directory): the site did not respond (502). Nothing confirmed.
Expat.com premium listing price: not shown to visitors without an account.
Yelo Data Hub prices: page not read.
Classified and listing sites (for example the classifieds of the main news groups): not examined within the fetch limit.

List prices in MUR from Mauritian providers for incorporating a domestic company, for registered office or company secretarial packages for a small domestic company, and for accounting or bookkeeping packages: none found. Six searches returned firms that quote on request. The only published schedules found are in USD and aimed at international or family office clients (Stonehage Fleming, Expanship).

Trade mark filing through an agent: one published price only (iGERENT). Kaizen CPA's Mauritius trade mark page now says to request a quotation. Official Industrial Property Office filing fees were not read.

Basic business website prices: only Nemesys (single page site MUR 4,999) and the Carril Agency guide ranges were confirmed. mauritius.biz is blocked by its robots.txt and gws-technologies.com returned 403, so prices seen for them in search results on a third-party listing site were not used.
Official registration fees (CBRD 'Fees Payable to the Registrar'): not read in this task.

Total advertising spend or digital advertising spend in Mauritius: no published figure found.
